svg.title: AIcoach — Other pages, card stack
svg.text: The rest of the app, in the same cards
One idea per screen. Every page is a short stack: the coach opens each card in serif, and anything that needs a decision opens in place, never in a pop-up.

g.text: Your swings are private to you.

svg.text: Sign in
One card. The coach greets you; the form is the whole page.

text.tspan: That email already has an account.
You can delete your account and every
swing from the Account page at any time.

svg.text: Create account
Error named in place, with the way out next to it.

g.text: 7 steps · about a minute to read

svg.text: Filming guide
Seven steps as folded cards. Each opens in place.

g.text: Whole body and club in frame.

the picture from address to finish.

Confirmation opens inside the card. No pop-up, both choices equal size.
